meta.name: agent-orchestration-advisor
meta.description: Design multi-agent AI workflows with clear boundaries, handoffs, and monitoring. Use when a complex PM task should run as parallel specialized agents instead of one linear process.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计多智能体协作流程，明确边界与交接
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目中协调多个AI智能体分工合作
copy.tagline_en: Design multi-agent workflows with clear boundaries and handoffs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to coordinate multiple AI agents in a project

howto.what: 用它时，Claude会通过提问，领着你把重复、耗时的任务拆成多个边界清晰的AI智能体并行运行，并帮你定好它们之间的交接和人工检查点，最后形成一份多智能体工作流的设计方案。
howto.when: 当你说想把复杂的产品管理工作拆成多个并行、各司其职的AI智能体来跑，而不是一条串行流程时，它会接管。例如：每周5小时以上的重复研究、可并行化的顺序步骤、需要规模化一致分析。

say.text: 我每周花6小时做竞品情报，能拆成几个并行跑的智能体吗？
say.note: 它会先了解现状，再判断是否适合编排。

say.text: 把我们这条又长又串行的AI工作流，改成并行多智能体架构。
say.note: 它会帮你拆出子任务并设计流程形态。

say.text: 帮我把客户反馈综合和路线图缺口分析，拆给不同智能体并行做。
say.note: 它会评估每步是否需要人工判断。

howto.what_en: It walks you through turning a repetitive PM task into multiple specialized AI agents that run in parallel, helping you set each agent's boundaries, handoffs, and human review points, and ends with a blueprint for the multi-agent workflow.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to turn a complex PM workflow into parallel specialized agents rather than a single linear process, e.g. weekly 5+ hour research, sequential tasks that can run in parallel, or consistency at scale.

say_en.text: I spend 6 hrs/week on competitive research - can we run that as parallel agents?
say_en.note: It first checks whether the task fits orchestration.

say_en.text: Our workflow runs sequentially - help restructure it into parallel agents.
say_en.note: It decomposes the task and proposes flow patterns.

say_en.text: Split customer synthesis and gap analysis into parallel specialized agents.
say_en.note: It flags steps that still need human judgment.
